package.name: buggy_nav_costmap
package.description: C++ lane planner - drop-in alternative to buggy_nav's freespace_grid_node (Python, own log-odds voxel grid). Occupancy comes directly from the latest LiDAR point cloud (transformed into a simple grid-hash once per planning cycle) instead of a persistent costmap - a Nav2 Costmap2DROS was tried first but its internal message filter kept dropping every observation regardless of fix attempted, so that whole subsystem was dropped. Same arc-based lane planning logic as before, with a strong pose-graph-direction bias.
